issue.title: Daily Headline: one line a day, shown wherever the week looks at its days
issue.description: Every daily note can carry one Bryan-written `**Headline:**` line naming the result that would make the day count. bob reads it (and never writes it) and serves it to the week note's Days table and strip, the weekly brief, the terminal, and the top of the Bob Mac Capture idle agenda. A concise POST checklist row in gtd_daily.md prompts it each morning.
